data.name: PRAJWAL KOTIAN
data.description: Full-stack developer with {years}+ years in the IT industry. Deep in UI libraries and frameworks like React, Redux and Angular (2+ and AngularJS), with backend knowledge of Spring Boot and Spring. Has worked across Scrum, SAFe Agile and Waterfall. Specialises in web accessibility, fixing CATO and Section 508 compliance issues. Hands-on with Jenkins CI/CD pipelines and AWS deployments. Looking to leverage this experience in a Senior UI Lead role.

description: As offshore Lead, conducted offshore DSU calls and guided the team on achieving targeted deliverables for sprint.
Performed role of UI SME in project by building a new React web application from scratch. Created reusable components like a Search Table with advanced filters.
Created new Spring Boot services and REST APIs for displaying data in UI. Working as Full Stack Developer, contributed to both front-end and back-end.
Handled performance related issues in the application and improved the data source queries.
Conducted 300+ interviews for Brillio internal and client recruitment.

workHistory.role: Application Developer Analyst - Application Development Team Lead
description: Worked as Technical POC and one of the UI SMEs in the SLA Reporting project with a team of 9-10 people. As a lead, was involved in story grooming, providing estimations and assigning stories to team members.

Successfully migrated the web application to Angular 8 from AngularJS for multiple application modules. Received client appreciation for increasing production page performance by 30%. Developed major functionality in most releases, live for 9000+ customers.

Involved in requirements and design calls with all AT&T stakeholders including Business and Architects. Came up with the overall design and created design and interface specification documents. Web Service integrations for all new products across Map and Maintenance modules.

Developed single sign-on into the B2B application for clients who use SLA reports. Migrated Spring Boot caching from Hazelcast to Redis. Implemented Apache Kafka for publishing recommendations to third party systems.
Fixed major CATO issues reported by the organization and resolved 508 violations. Supported modules through to production release.

Knowledge transfer of functional/technical flows to new team members. Mentored junior team members and up-skilled newcomers. Gave KT on CATO (Corporate Accessibility Technology Office), which ensures client products and services are accessible to all customers.
